title: 安田記念の後に・確かな異変

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki astounds and enraptures the audience at the Yasuda Kinen, and her fans' expectations for her continue to swell. Yet, I can't help but feel that something was off about her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My unease grows stronger, and I rush to find her. Unfortunately, a worried Hishi Amazon informs me that Fuji Kiseki has left without me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race is the autumn Tenno Sho. But first, I need to find out what's wrong with Fuji Kiseki.
